question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mo>:</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>a</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math> be a parabola with focus <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi></math>.Let the tangents to the parabola <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> make an angle of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac></math> with the line <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn></math> touch the parabola <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math>. Then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi></math> for which <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>B</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi></math> are collinear is:

solution.text:
Lines making angle π4 with y=3x+5 

So using formula tanα=m2-m11+m1m2, we have slope -2 & 12.

Which are perpendicular to each-other so, A, S, Bare collinear for all a>0. (by property that perpendicular tangents will lie on directrix and chord of contact will pass through focus, so the points are collinear )
